chunks: And from his (peace be upon him) will/testament to 'Abdullah ibn al-'Abbas, when he sent him to argue/contend with the Kharijites.

key_terms.الِاحْتِجَاجِ: Arguing or presenting evidence/contending in debate
key_terms.الْخَوَارِجِ: The Kharijites, a early Islamic sect known for their rebellion against Ali ibn Abi Talib

ai.seo_question: What was the context of Imam Ali's instruction to Abdullah ibn al-Abbas regarding the Kharijites?
ai.summary: This introduction sets the stage for Imam Ali’s strategic guidance to Abdullah ibn al-Abbas, highlighting the latter's role as a learned envoy tasked with countering the Kharijites' rigid literalism and political rebellion. The context underscores the Shia emphasis on using intellectual argumentation (hujjah) to resolve disputes, framing the confrontation not merely as a military or political struggle but as a theological clarification of authority and justice.
